input.lugar: a rustic lodge on the bank of an Amazon river near Iquitos, Peru (not a real identifiable lodge)
input.escena: seen from the water, a simple wooden dock enters the river; behind it, among tall trees, two or three raised cabins with palm-thatch roofs; a woman traveler with a backpack steps from the boat onto the dock. It must read as arriving at a rustic lodge in the middle of the forest, not a resort or city hotel
input.clima: humid cloudy sky without rain, abundant natural light filtered by the trees, open shadows, sky highlights retained
input.refLugar: Peruvian Amazon riverbank vegetation, water colour and traditional wooden riverside architecture
input.prohibir: swimming pools or resort infrastructure, posed wildlife, a real identifiable lodge, readable signs
input.extra: COMPOSITION, MEASURED: the cabins among the trees and the woman stepping onto the dock (small, between 22% and 48% of the frame height, centred between 40% and 60% of the width) sit in the upper half. The lower half is the calm dark river water and the out-of-focus bow of the boat. SKY BRANDLIFT CONSISTENCY (Daniela Ferreira, SKY Blog visual system, sheet 15): believable traveler POV at eye height; luminous natural light with open shadows and whites that keep detail; natural colour where ochres, blues and skin keep their true tones, moderate contrast, no filter, no orange-teal grade, no HDR; real optical depth: the near element very out of focus with soft optical bokeh, the subject sharp; a spontaneous everyday moment, no pose. LENS: 28–35 mm equivalent, contextual and immersive.
